title: Technical English — Course 5, Semester 1 — Pilot Variant 8

tasks.prompt: Listening 1. When will the non-conformance lesson begin?
tasks.audioText: The quality assurance tutor will introduce non-conformance reports on Tuesday at one. Students should bring the sample inspection result and corrective-action form. The lesson will distinguish a requirement, an observed deviation and the action proposed to address it. Students will practise writing factual descriptions without assigning blame.

tasks.prompt: Listening 2. Which two forms should students bring?
tasks.audioText: The quality assurance tutor will introduce non-conformance reports on Tuesday at one. Students should bring the sample inspection result and corrective-action form. The lesson will distinguish a requirement, an observed deviation and the action proposed to address it. Students will practise writing factual descriptions without assigning blame.
options: The inspection result and corrective-action form

tasks.prompt: A non-conformance is a failure to meet a specified requirement. A report should identify the requirement, describe the evidence and state how the actual result differs. The cause may require further investigation. Corrective action should address the cause rather than only the visible symptom, and its effectiveness should be reviewed. Clear records support traceability and help prevent recurrence. Reading 1. What does a non-conformance represent?
options: A failure to meet a specified requirement

tasks.prompt: The observed deviation ___ in the report.
Choose TWO elements of a useful non-conformance report.
A failure to meet a specified requirement is a non-___.
An inspection result differs from the specified requirement. What should you record?
options: The observed condition differs from the specified requirement; the evidence is recorded for review.
I will copy an unrelated record.

tasks.prompt: Put the stages of non-conformance reporting in a logical order.
options: Investigate the cause and review corrective action
correctOrder: Investigate the cause and review corrective action

tasks.prompt: Write 80–100 words explaining how a non-conformance should be reported and why corrective action must address the cause and be checked for effectiveness.
tasks.rubric: 8 points total: task completion and relevant content (0–2); clear organisation and logical linking (0–2); grammar and sentence structure (0–2); accurate maintenance and quality vocabulary, spelling and punctuation (0–2).
